# Bundled third-party code

`lucide` holds the pinned Lucide 1.59.0 catalog and the source font. The Lucide ISC and Feather MIT notices are in
`lucide/LICENSE`. The generated panel font is `main/ui/fonts/deck_lucide_60.c`; stored icon IDs must stay stable
across later updates. LVGL 9.6, cJSON and the board drivers are fetched by ESP-IDF's component manager.
